gen-gf-warnes-gf-aclonica: Aclonica carries a deep midsection through every lowercase word. Warnes does best with ruler-straight strokes and stretched, spacious tracking, while Aclonica does best with long, widely spaced lines and a mild thickness shift.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-alumni-sans-sc: Warnes stretches out in spacious, uncontrasted strokes that taper before touching, while Alumni Sans SC squeezes its letters tight. Paragraphs of it feel dense, compact and quietly contemporary.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-arsenal-sc: Arsenal SC fits its letters tight, with a faint thick-thin shift. Warnes is best at pure, unmodulated lines with no pinched joins or swelling bowls, whereas Arsenal SC is best at wide-mouthed, modestly stressed curves.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-cal-sans: Warnes tapers its ink strokes out before they ever touch. Cal Sans keeps one stroke width through the whole alphabet, with short ascenders and a tall x-height that feel modern and approachable.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-geist-mono: Structured and technical, fixed-width letters with generous side gaps sit beneath Warnes, whose stretched tracking is just as spacious. Geist Mono moves along at a steady, code-like tempo, each character given its own slot.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-inder: Loud and stretched, Warnes tapers its ink with no contrast at all, while Inder keeps lowercase and capitals close in height. Text in Inder moves along smoothly, clean and businesslike.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-magra: Rope-thin and stretched out: Warnes draws every outline without swelling or thinning, while Magra fills each lowercase word with big-bodied presence. Magra stays professional and low-key beside all that flourish.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-mukta-malar: Mukta Malar keeps its ascenders compressed and its manner approachable, tucked beneath Warnes, whose tapering ink strokes never quite touch. Rope-like uniform curves up top are the real hook.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-noto-sans-display: Noto Sans Display gives every word a big, tall middle zone, sitting under Warnes and its neon-glass tubes of line. The pair's best feature is that glowing, widely spaced heading.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-play: Play reads cleanly, with little height difference between cases and joins that taper modestly without vanishing. Yet Warnes, uniform in line and widely tracked, leaves the body text feeling quiet and steady.
